SELECT INTR.INTERVIEW_NO AS INTR_INTERVIEW_NO, INTR.PROCESS_NO AS INTR_PROCESS_NO, INTR.INTERVIEW_DATE AS INTR_INTERVIEW_DATE, INTR.INTERVIEW_LOCATION AS INTR_INTERVIEW_LOCATION, INTR.INTERVIEW_TYPE AS INTR_INTERVIEW_TYPE, INTR.INTERVIEW_PASS_SCORE AS INTR_INTERVIEW_PASS_SCORE,
REPR.RECRUIT_PROCESS_NO AS REPR_RECRUIT_PROCESS_NO, REPR.RECRUITMENT_NO AS REPR_RECRUITMENT_NO, REPR.COMPANY_NAME AS REPR_COMPANY_NAME, REPR.RECRUIT_PROCESS_STEP AS REPR_RECRUIT_PROCESS_STEP, REPR.RECRUIT_PROCESS_FINAL AS REPR_RECRUIT_PROCESS_FINAL, REPR.RECRUIT_PROCESS_TYPE AS REPR_RECRUIT_PROCESS_TYPE,
RENO.RECRUITMENT_NO AS RENO_RECRUITMENT_NO, RENO.USER_ID AS RENO_USER_ID, RENO.JOB_CODE AS RENO_JOB_CODE, RENO.YEAR_CODE AS RENO_YEAR_CODE, RENO.REC_CONTENT AS RENO_REC_CONTENT, RENO.PREFERENTIAL AS RENO_PREFERENTIAL, RENO.CITY_CODE AS RENO_CITY_CODE, RENO.DISTRICT_CODE AS RENO_DISTRICT_CODE, RENO.REC_POSITION_NUMBER AS RENO_REC_POSITION_NUMBER, RENO.RECRUITMENT_CHARGER_TEL AS RENO_RECRUITMENT_CHARGER_TEL, RENO.RECRUITMENT_SALARY AS RENO_RECRUITMENT_SALARY, RENO.WELFARE AS RENO_WELFARE, RENO.RECRUITMENT_DESK AS RENO_RECRUITMENT_DESK, RENO.RECRUITMENT_IMG AS RENO_RECRUITMENT_IMG, RENO.RECRUITMENT_STARTDATE AS RENO_RECRUITMENT_STARTDATE, RENO.RECRUITMENT_RECEIPT_START AS RENO_RECRUITMENT_RECEIPT_START, RENO.RECRUITMENT_FINISH_DATE AS RENO_RECRUITMENT_FINISH_DATE, RENO.RECRUITMENT_TITLE AS RENO_RECRUITMENT_TITLE, RENO.RECRUIMENT_DEL_DATE AS RENO_RECRUIMENT_DEL_DATE,
APRE.APPLICANT_RECORD_NO AS APRE_APPLICANT_RECORD_NO, APRE.RECRUITMENT_NO AS APRE_RECRUITMENT_NO, APRE.APPLICANT_ID AS APRE_APPLICANT_ID, APRE.STEP_PASS_YN AS APRE_STEP_PASS_YN, APRE.STEP_APPLICATION_YN AS APRE_STEP_APPLICATION_YN, APRE.INTERVIEW_URL AS APRE_INTERVIEW_URL, APRE.EVALUATION_START_TIME AS APRE_EVALUATION_START_TIME FROM INTERVIEW INTR LEFT OUTER JOIN RECRUIT_PROCESS REPR ON INTR.PROCESS_NO = REPR.RECRUIT_PROCESS_NO LEFT OUTER JOIN RECRUITMENT_NOTICE RENO ON RENO.RECRUITMENT_NO = REPR.RECRUITMENT_NO LEFT OUTER JOIN APPLICANT_RECORD APRE ON APRE.RECRUITMENT_NO = REPR.RECRUIT_PROCESS_NO
SELECT INTERVIEW_NO , PROCESS_NO , INTERVIEW_DATE , INTERVIEW_LOCATION , INTERVIEW_TYPE , INTERVIEW_PASS_SCORE FROM INTERVIEW WHERE INTERVIEW_NO = #{interviewNo}
